selection_rule: Minimum predeclared primary MAE; no score-informed new candidates or tuning
baseline: recent_8week, analytical baseline, not customer incumbent
interpretation: Small development error difference; no externally supplied practical improvement threshold. Not proof of business benefit, true demand accuracy, or superiority over an unspecified incumbent.
gate_reasons: No externally predeclared meaningful improvement threshold
No claim that fixed extract statuses reconstruct historical knowledge
measurement_limits: Candidate processes ran concurrently, one CPU thread each; elapsed values include contention and import effects. Absolute high-water process RSS includes preparation, fitting, inference, retained comparison outputs and imported libraries; it bounds both fit and inference but cannot isolate their incremental memory.
